items.quote: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
items.claim: The text (Genesis 20:17) says that after Abraham prayed to God, God healed Abimelech, his wife and his maidservants, and they then had children.
items.action: prayed unto God (intercession) leading to healing
items.object: Abimelech, his wife, and his maidservants
items.mechanism: intercessory prayer followed by divine healing, restoring the ability to bear children
items.place: Gerar (from surrounding chapter context, not stated in this verse; model-prior)
